_doc: Reward icons (the three 'stars'): capacitor, integrated circuit, coil, in the Toybox direction. Big takes are drawn at half the game size and scaled x2 by tools/art/tiles/robot-cell.mjs (which also derives the greyed BW variants); minis are their own 24 px takes cropped to the old mini sizes. See docs/art/classes/terrain.md. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

shared.capSubject: Subject: an electrolytic capacitor standing upright: a chunky rounded cylinder can in sky blue with a cream stripe down one side and a slightly domed silver top, two short straight silver wire legs coming out of the bottom. Straight front view, symmetric, centred.
shared.chipSubject: Subject: an integrated circuit microchip seen straight from above: a rounded dark navy square chip body with a small cream dot in one corner and a tiny cute robot face printed in sunny yellow in the middle, short silver pins sticking out evenly along all four sides. Flat top-down, symmetric, centred.
shared.coilSubject: Subject: a toroid inductor coil seen straight from the front: a fat ring (doughnut) wrapped all around with shiny copper-orange wire windings, the cream ring core peeking through between the windings, a round hole in the middle. Straight front view, symmetric, centred.
shared.miniNote: Tiny icon: very simple, only the main shape and 2-3 colours, thick outline.

defaults.negative: text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, glow, shadow, ground plate, hands, character, frame, border

recipes.subject: Subject: a tiny icon of an electrolytic capacitor standing upright: a sky-blue rounded cylinder can with a cream stripe and a silver top, two short silver legs. Very simple, only the main shape, thick dark outline, fills the canvas height.

Subject: a tiny icon of a microchip seen from above: a dark navy square with short silver pins on all four sides and one sunny yellow dot in the middle. Very simple, thick dark outline, fills the canvas.
Subject: a tiny icon of a toroid coil: a fat copper-orange ring (doughnut) with a few dark wire stripes and a round hole in the middle. Very simple, thick dark outline, fills the canvas.

Subject: a tiny icon of an electrolytic capacitor: a tall narrow upright sky-blue cylinder, about two thirds as wide as it is tall, with a cream vertical stripe on the right and a flat silver top, two short silver legs at the bottom. Very simple, thick dark outline, fills the canvas height.

Subject: a tiny icon of a toroid coil: a fat ring with a round hole in the middle, wrapped in thick copper-orange wire windings with mint green core showing between them. Very simple, thick dark outline, fills the canvas.
